WITH budget_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    (spent - amount) / CAST(amount AS REAL) AS ratio
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount != 0
),
event_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event AS event_id,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM budget_ratios
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
ranked_events AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.location,
    ear.avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.location ORDER BY ear.avg_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank
  FROM event_avg_ratios ear
  JOIN event e ON ear.event_id = e.event_id
  WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL AND e.location != ''
)
SELECT 
  event_id,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 are excluded to prevent division by zero errors. Only budget lines with non-zero amounts contribute to each event's average ratio.
